title: P48 follow-up: double pretraining entropy bonus to 0.02
description: P48 follow-up: increase only the pretraining predictive-entropy reward coefficient from incumbent 0.01 to 0.02 on the same supervised proof-token positions. A stronger reward for plausible alternatives may improve discovery and downstream transfer under fixed expert iteration.
hypothesis: Incumbent 052-codex scored 292/300/249 (exact mean 280.333333), improving on 043-codex by only 5 mean solves with mixed paired effects. This is weak evidence, not proof of a monotonic benefit. No prior registration tests predictive-entropy coefficient 0.02; earlier label smoothing 0.02 is a distinct distribution-independent objective and failed. Doubling the distribution-dependent entropy reward may preserve useful alternatives and improve first-round discovery on at least two seeds, compounding into a higher final dev-transfer mean. It may instead diffuse correct syntax and amplify invalid continuations, as other regularizers have done. This changes every existing supervised token uniformly, including termination; no token selection, data reweighting, sampler change, or RL feedback is introduced. The fixed three-seed downstream mean alone decides keep/discard.
expected_delta: Conditional on improvement, +3 to +15 dev-transfer solves at true length >=7 versus incumbent exact mean 280.333333; plausible downside -10 to -60. Predict first-round sample accuracy exceeds 052 values 0.04379/0.06625/0.04967 on at least two seeds. Same operations and model imply no intrinsic pretraining or per-token inference overhead; hardware throughput and generated lengths may still vary. Budgets stay 300 seconds pretraining and 1200 seconds total.

optimizer.name: split-QKV Muon hidden matrices throughout; continuous AdamW auxiliary

muon.precision: bf16 Newton-Schulz; fp32 momentum and parameters
muon.shape_scale: sqrt(max(1, rows/columns)) per orthogonalized matrix: Q/K/V each 1, attention output 1, fc1 2, fc2 1
muon.schedule: same warmup/cosine fraction as AdamW; muon_lr = 0.01 * adam_lr / 0.001
muon.parameters: All 16 hidden projection parameters remain in Muon. Four qkv.weight matrices of shape (768,256) use independent Q/K/V updates, represented as a batch of three (256,256) matrices; proj/fc1/fc2 remain unchanged.
muon.license: MIT; full copyright and permission notice retained in pretrain.py
muon.qkv_split: After elementwise Nesterov momentum, reshape each QKV update to (3,256,256); independently Frobenius-normalize and run five batched Newton-Schulz steps; reshape back before applying. No extra learning-rate multiplier. Momentum and weight decay stay elementwise and unchanged.

optimizer.adamw_parameters: emb.weight, head.weight, all projection biases and LayerNorm parameters throughout; hidden matrices never enter pretraining AdamW
optimizer.decay_convention: Muon lr*0.01 equals auxiliary AdamW lr*0.1, preserving incumbent per-update shrinkage at every schedule fraction, including the former finish window; integrated decay can differ with throughput.
optimizer.clipping: joint global gradient norm 1.0 before both optimizers
optimizer.handoff: standard GPT weights only; pretraining optimizer states are discarded and frozen RL creates its own unchanged AdamW

config.init: Fork default construction, then orthogonal_ on every 2D block parameter after moving to device. Gain = 0.02 * sqrt(max(rows, columns)); exact element second moment 0.0004. All 16 hidden matrices: qkv (768,256), proj (256,256), fc1 (1024,256), fc2 (256,1024) in each of four blocks. QKV initialized jointly. Embedding, readout, biases and LayerNorm retain their original draws/values. No reinitialization during RL.

loss.name: hard-target cross entropy minus predictive entropy bonus
loss.formula: mean over mask[:,1:] of CE(logits,x[:,1:]) - 0.02 * H(softmax(logits))
loss.precision: logits cast to fp32; entropy from log_softmax then exp; gradients through probabilities and log-probabilities
loss.supervision: Identical shifted proof-token mask and token-average denominator as fork train.loss_on; includes ordinary supervised EOS; no token reweighting or dataset modification.
loss.validation: Unchanged hard-target cross entropy via fork loss_on. Training curve includes entropy reward and is not directly comparable with baseline CE.
loss.handoff: Plain fork GPT returned without loss wrappers, hooks, auxiliary modules, or optimizer state. Frozen RL calls its unchanged hard-target loss and optimizer.
